company.name: Adzily
company.shortDescription: Adzily is a digital advertising platform that mix between traditional advertising and digital advertising.
company.description:
Adzily is a digital advertising platform that mixes between traditional advertising and digital advertising. Users can reach their audience using Display screens and get rich audience insights available on digital advertising as well. Adzily is the first indoor advertising platform in MENA. The network is available in the most crowded places such as Cafes, Restaurants, and Gyms.

It was founded in 2018 by Ahmed Ashoor, Mostafa Hendawy, Mostafa Kamshish, and Mohamed Ossman. It is headquartered in Sheikh Zayed City, Egypt.
